proposed_widenings.name: MagicItemComponentMechanics.ongoing_effect
proposed_widenings.justification: The item has a real magic-item activation that creates a timed persistent aura over an area. Current magic-item mechanics only allow passive grants or immediate activation phases; they cannot honestly encode a planted aura with ongoing area-scoped effects and a later manual end action.
proposed_widenings.evidence: "While in that Bright Light, you and your allies gain a +1 bonus to Armor Class and saving throws and can sense the location of any Invisible creature that is also in the Bright Light."

notes: Held passive bonuses and held spell access fit existing composite magic-item mechanics, but the Protective Aura does not. I did not author placeholder content because that would require lying about a persistent aura as a one-shot activation.
